name: io.github.bitgett/q402-mcp
description: Q402 — gasless USDC, USDT, and RLUSD payments across 9 EVM chains, callable from any MCP client. Eight tools (q402_doctor for first-install + 7 runtime tools). Recommended setup path: install with `claude mcp add q402 -- npx -y @quackai/q402-mcp` (or your client's equivalent), then ask your AI 'Set up Q402' — q402_doctor creates ~/.q402/mcp.env and walks you through pasting your API key + wallet private key in your editor (never in chat). The env-variable entries below are only needed if you'd rather inject secrets directly via your MCP client's env-var management.

environmentVariables.name: Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install — it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Free Trial API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/event — BNB Chain only, 2,000 sponsored TXs, gas covered by Q402. BNB payments auto-route to this key when set (same rule for q402_pay and q402_batch_pay up to 5 recipients).

environmentVariables.name: Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install — it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Paid Multichain API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/payment — full 9-chain support with per-chain Gas Tank. Auto-routed for non-BNB payments and whenever keyScope='multichain' is chosen.

environmentVariables.name: Q402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install — it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads (and never round-trips through chat). Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) used to sign payment authorizations LOCALLY on your machine. Use a fresh wallet, not your main one.

environmentVariables.name: Q402_ENABLE_REAL_PAYMENTS
environmentVariables.description: Live-mode switch. 0 = sandbox (test mode, no funds move — every q402_pay returns a fake hash). 1 = real on-chain payments. Default 1 since v0.5.11: safe because mode only flips to live when BOTH a live API key (q402_live_*) AND a valid 32-byte private key are configured. Without those, the server stays in sandbox regardless of this flag.

environmentVariables.name: Q402_MAX_AMOUNT_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Per-call USD-equivalent cap. Any q402_pay request with amount above this is rejected before signing.

environmentVariables.name: Q402_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated lowercase EVM addresses. When set, q402_pay rejects any recipient not on this allowlist.

environmentVariables.name: Q402_RELAY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override for the Q402 relay endpoint. Defaults to https://q402.quackai.ai/api. Set explicitly when running against a self-hosted Q402 deployment or a non-canonical environment.
